purpose: Current direct expected/intended Participation relation between one canonical Event and one Person; required/optional is planning semantics, never attendance truth.

columns.name: event_ref
columns.meaning: Canonical Event whose expected participation is described.

columns.name: participant_person_ref
columns.meaning: Native Person expected or intended to participate; Account identity is not required.

columns.name: requirement_code
columns.meaning: Bounded create-planning requirement: required or optional; not invitation response or Actual attendance.

columns.name: established_at
columns.meaning: Server-side accepted instant supplied by the B09-B guarded operation.

primary_key.name: pk_event_expected_participation
primary_key.reason: One current direct expected-participation relation per Event/Person pair in the activated B09 subset.

foreign_keys.name: fk_event_expected_participation_event
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Participation is contextual to an existing Event and does not own Event identity.

foreign_keys.name: fk_event_expected_participation_participant_person
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Participant is a contextual role over Person identity, never a Participant entity or Account alias.

check_constraints.name: ck_event_expected_participation_requirement
check_constraints.reason: B09-A activates only the existing Create required/optional expectation vocabulary; response and attendance remain distinct.

indexes.name: ix_event_expected_participation_person_event
indexes.reason: Reverse lookup of expected Events for a Person.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Not Domain MaterialState; this table is the current direct intended relation only.
state_history.current_binding: Current required/optional expected Participation for one Event/Person pair.
state_history.chronology: B09-B records each accepted change in event_expected_participation_operation; Actual Participation remains outside this table.
state_history.immutability_policy: No direct runtime writes; current expectation changes only through set_self_event_expected_participation.

lifecycle.retention: Current relation only; accepted removals are recorded on the B09-B operation receipt.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: Runtime raw DELETE is denied; B09-B removes by capability.

obligations: Participant references Person, not Account or a Participant identity.
Required/optional expectation remains distinct from response and Actual attendance.
No runtime raw writes; B09-B mutates only through the guarded capability.
